stage13_round4_summary: Round-4 (2026-08-14) OVERTURNS rounds 1-3 on the physics. Rounds 1-3 verified that L1 cited `natural_range_disjoint_from_ligo_window` consistently; none of them checked whether the theorem's STATEMENT matched the prose. It did not. That theorem is a two-point statement about chi_vest in {0.1, 10}; the prose read it as an interval disjointness. The compatible window is in fact nested strictly INSIDE the natural range and shares chi_vest = 1 with it, so the claim that the two are 'entirely disjoint' was false, as was 'fails GW170817 over the entire natural range'. The theorem was renamed `natural_endpoints_violate_ligo_window` (its name was a misnomer), and `ligo_confines_chi_vest_within_natural_range`, `ligo_window_subset_natural_range`, `ligo_window_inter_natural_range_nonempty` and `ligo_window_width_lt_natural_range_width_by_1e14` were added to state and prove what is actually true: GW170817 CONFINES chi_vest to a window narrower than the natural range by >14 orders of magnitude. Title, abstract, intro, Sec.~4 and Discussion were rewritten from falsification to confinement. Separately, the attribution of c_GW = c*sqrt(chi_vest) to Volovik was corrected: the IDENTIFICATION is his, but the susceptibility-dependent speed is this project's, obtained by transplanting it onto the ADW substrate; Volovik's own de Sitter computation gives s_2 = c exactly (chi_vest = 1), which is GW170817-compatible. Round-3's '21 theorems' count was also stale (32 at HEAD). Names appearing in rounds 1-3 summaries above are retained as accurate HISTORY; `natural_range_disjoint_from_ligo_window` and `second_sound_graviton_natural_range_universally_falsified` no longer exist.
